title: More building blocks for React apps
summary:
New alpha building blocks for app developers, a replacement backend for Klein images, and a README news refresh.

The team added `fetchModelCatalog()` and a client import path to the SDK, alongside a token-based theme system, new UI primitives, a category-filtered ModelSelector, and an AppUserMenu. Both package updates are alpha releases; their READMEs recommend pinning exact versions.

FLUX.2 Klein 4B was pointed at a replacement image-generation backend to address 5xx errors after its previous host became unreachable.

An agent updated Latest News with June 3 notes on `nova-fast` routing and faster Dashboard balance checks, replacing older entries.

highlights.title: Model catalog in the SDK
highlights.text: The SDK alpha adds `fetchModelCatalog()` for normalized image, video, text, and audio model metadata, plus allowed-model ID sets. It also adds the `@pollinations/sdk/client` import path. [Explore the SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk).

highlights.title: More React UI building blocks
highlights.text: The UI alpha adds themed primitives, a category-filtered ModelSelector, and an AppUserMenu for authorization, balance, top-up, and logout. [Explore the React UI](https://react.pollinations.ai).
